title: Garlic Fried Rice
steps: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat until it is hot but not smoking, ensuring the surface is evenly coated.
Add finely chopped garlic and sauté gently while stirring continuously until golden brown and fragrant without burning.
Add leftover rice into the pan and carefully break apart all clumps using a spatula to separate each grain.
Mix thoroughly and season lightly with salt, stirring for several minutes until the rice is fully heated and slightly toasted before serving.

title: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Heat oil evenly in a wide pan and allow it to reach medium heat.
Crack eggs directly into the pan and cook while scrambling slowly until they form soft curds.
Add cooked rice and gently break apart any clumps while mixing with the eggs.
Continue stirring while seasoning lightly with salt, ensuring even distribution of egg throughout the rice before serving hot.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Cut chicken into small bite-sized pieces and cook in heated oil until golden brown and fully cooked through.
Add cooked rice into the pan and use a spatula to break any clumps to ensure even mixing.
Combine chicken and rice thoroughly while stirring continuously to distribute flavors evenly.
Season lightly and cook for several minutes more until the entire dish is heated evenly before serving warm.

title: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Heat oil in a pan and ensure it coats the surface evenly before adding ingredients.
Add chopped vegetables and cook while stirring continuously until slightly softened but still crisp.
Add rice and gently break apart any clumps to avoid uneven cooking.
Mix thoroughly and cook for several minutes while lightly seasoning before serving hot.

title: Pork Rice Bowl
steps: Slice pork into thin pieces and cook in oil over medium heat until browned and fully cooked.
Prepare freshly cooked rice and place it in a bowl while still warm.
Arrange cooked pork evenly over the rice so juices can soak into the grains.
Serve immediately while hot for best texture and flavor.

title: Chicken Vegetable Stir Fry
steps: Slice chicken into thin strips and cook in heated oil until nearly done.
Add chopped vegetables and stir fry continuously to ensure even cooking without burning.
Continue cooking until the vegetables are slightly tender but still retain some crunch.
Season lightly and serve immediately while hot, preferably with rice.

title: Egg Omelette
steps: Beat eggs thoroughly in a bowl with a small amount of salt until fully combined.
Heat oil in a pan and pour in the egg mixture, spreading it evenly across the surface.
Allow the eggs to cook slowly until the bottom becomes firm while the top remains slightly soft.
Flip carefully and cook the remaining side until fully set before serving immediately.

title: Vegetable Omelette
steps: Chop vegetables into small pieces and mix them into beaten eggs.
Heat oil in a pan and pour in the mixture, spreading it evenly.
Allow the omelette to cook gently until the bottom is firm enough to flip.
Turn carefully and finish cooking until both sides are fully set and serve warm.

title: Chicken Rice Simple
steps: Cook chicken in a pan until fully tender and evenly browned on all sides.
Prepare rice separately and keep it warm until ready to serve.
Slice or shred the cooked chicken into manageable pieces.
Serve chicken over rice, allowing the juices to enhance the overall flavor.

title: Vegetable Rice Bowl
steps: Cook rice until soft and fluffy, ensuring proper water absorption.
Cook vegetables separately until slightly tender but not overcooked.
Place vegetables over the rice evenly to distribute flavor.
Mix gently before eating or serve layered while warm.

title: Egg Rice Bowl
steps: Prepare freshly cooked rice and keep it hot.
Cook eggs according to preference, such as scrambled or fried.
Place the eggs over the rice while still hot.
Break and mix the eggs slightly into the rice before eating for better flavor distribution.

title: Chicken Rice Stir
steps: Cook chicken pieces in oil until fully cooked and slightly browned.
Add cooked rice to the pan and break apart all clumps.
Mix thoroughly to ensure the rice absorbs the chicken flavor.
Cook for several more minutes until evenly heated before serving.

title: Vegetable Stir Fry
steps: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat until evenly hot.
Add vegetables and cook while stirring frequently to prevent burning.
Continue cooking until vegetables soften slightly while maintaining texture.
Season lightly and serve immediately while hot.

title: Chicken Soup
steps: Bring water to a boil in a pot and add chicken pieces.
Reduce heat and allow it to simmer slowly until chicken becomes tender.
Skim off any impurities that rise to the surface for clearer broth.
Season lightly and serve hot as a comforting meal.

title: Vegetable Soup
steps: Bring water to boiling temperature before adding vegetables.
Allow the vegetables to cook slowly while reducing heat to a simmer.
Stir occasionally and ensure all vegetables soften evenly.
Season lightly with salt and serve hot.

title: Chicken Vegetable Rice
steps: Cook chicken until tender and fully browned.
Add vegetables and cook briefly until slightly softened.
Combine mixture with prepared rice and mix thoroughly.
Continue cooking briefly before serving hot.

title: Egg and Potato Mix
steps: Dice potatoes and cook in oil until tender and lightly browned.
Add beaten eggs into the pan and stir gently.
Combine evenly and cook until eggs are fully set.
Serve warm as a simple filling meal.

title: Rice and Meat Plate
